name: Multi-Step Causal Chain Reasoning
description: Given a sequence of events, identify all causal relationships and predict downstream effects up to 5 steps ahead.
input_format: A list of events with timestamps and observed outcomes
output_format: A directed causal graph with predicted effects and confidence scores
steps: Parse each event and extract cause-effect pairs
Build a directed acyclic graph of relationships
Propagate effects forward through the chain
Return graph and final predicted state

example.input: Event A causes B; B causes C and D; D causes E
